result:
I implemented `Intl.Collator` (constructor, `resolvedOptions`, the `compare` getter and `CompareStrings`) using ICU4X. 126 of 130 runs under `intl402/Collator/` pass. `cargo clippy` is clean.

The 4 failures are two tests, each failing in sloppy and strict mode:
- **`usage-de.js`:** ICU4X's compiled data has no search collations, so `usage: "search"` falls back to the sort collation and "AE" and "Ä" still sort the sort way.
- **`this-value-ignored.js`:** it calls `Intl.NumberFormat`, which isn't implemented yet.

BLOCKED: `usage-de.js` needs ICU4X search-collation data (`-u-co-search` for `de`), which the compiled data doesn't include; `this-value-ignored.js` needs `Intl.NumberFormat`.
